cases.prefill_note: The model reliably routes 'authenticator code for <name>' to the credential-listing family (get_credentials/cred_list) instead of totp — an adjacent-family selection ambiguity that tool descriptions and prompt wording could not override (verified across runs). For a clean exemplar we pin the tool name (through the trailing comma, so the emitted JSON stays well-formed — without it the model sometimes drops the separator) and let the model fill the arguments; the selection error itself is documented, not aliased away. This is the only case needing a non-default prefill.
